# Frame Cipher

> Frame Cipher is a premier 360 marketing, media production, branding, website development, software engineering, and growth architecture agency based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Headquartered on the 6th Floor of Eurasia Building, Matikata ECB Chattar, Dhaka 1206.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [360 Marketing Systems](https://framecipher.info/services/360-marketing): Full-funnel growth operating systems uniting brand strategy, creative media, high-converting landing pages, SEO, and paid performance advertising.
- [Paid Advertising Engine](https://framecipher.info/services/paid-advertising): Enterprise media buying across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Advantage+), Google Ads (Search & Performance Max), TikTok Ads, and AI Conversational Search (ChatGPT Ads).
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://framecipher.info/services/seo): Technical SEO audits, programmatic SEO, topical authority architecture, on-page optimization, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO).
- [Website Design & Development](https://framecipher.info/services/website-design-development): Custom Next.js web applications, headless commerce, high-speed Shopify stores, corporate portals, and conversion-engineered landing pages.
- [App & Software Development](https://framecipher.info/services/app-development): Scalable mobile applications (iOS, Android, React Native), SaaS web platforms, backend API integrations, and MVPs.
- [Social Media Management](https://framecipher.info/services/social-media-management): Data-driven content calendars, community management, viral short-form video creation, and executive thought leadership on LinkedIn.
- [Content Creation & Studio Media](https://framecipher.info/services/content-creation): High-end video production, 3D motion graphics, brand identity systems, corporate documentaries, and product photography.

## Physical Studio Facilities (Dhaka)

- [Frame Cipher Studio Hub](https://framecipher.info/studio): Dedicated sound-isolated physical studio stage at Matikata ECB Chattar, Dhaka 1206.
- [Podcast Recording Studio](https://framecipher.info/studio/podcast): Acoustically treated multi-mic broadcast audio and multi-angle 4K video podcast recording suites.
- [Corporate Video Production](https://framecipher.info/studio/corporate-video-production): Executive messages, brand overviews, company profiles, and investor pitches.
- [Commercial & TVC Production](https://framecipher.info/studio/commercial-video-production): High-retention television commercials and digital ad creative.
- [Product Photography](https://framecipher.info/studio/product-photography): Controlled lighting, pure-white backgrounds (Daraz & Shopify compliant), and lifestyle staging.
- [Studio Space Rental](https://framecipher.info/studio/rental): Hourly and daily production space rental with overhead continuous lighting grid and generator power backup.

- [Marketing Calculators Suite](https://framecipher.info/calculators): Free enterprise advertising budget, unit economic, and Break-Even ROAS planning tools.
- [Google Ads Budget & Quality Score Simulator](https://framecipher.info/calculators/google-ads): Model Quality Score CPC discounts, Search Impression Share, and Target CPA.
- [Meta Ads Budget & ROAS Wizard](https://framecipher.info/calculators/meta-ads): Advantage+ shopping campaign budget pacing and break-even unit economics.
- [TikTok Ads Video Retention Planner](https://framecipher.info/calculators/tiktok-ads): 6-second video view retention rates and Spark Ads media allocation.
- [ChatGPT & Generative AI Search Ads Calculator](https://framecipher.info/calculators/chatgpt-ads): Conversational sponsored answer citation modeling and CPC forecasts.
- [Advertising Metrics Encyclopedia](https://framecipher.info/tools/ads-calculator#metrics-encyclopedia): Complete diagnostic playbooks for ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, and MER.
